# Open Shortcut

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Opens the shortcut editor to the specified Shortcut.

## Syntax

~~~~text
openShortcut(name: <#Workflow#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
openShortcut(name: Jellycuts Helper)
~~~~
